description: While mapping the Houston ACG deck to the DRC Talent Labs talk, presented unverified HR proof points as facts (IBM AskHR ~94% of routine queries, Unilever AI recruiting funnel, Walmart employee assistant, J&J talent marketplace) and proposed re-plotting the Time Impact x Demand Limit scatter/2x2 with HR job families, treating what is actual underlying data as a decorative representation. David corrected: the 2x2 and scatter are real data and must not be touched, and the HR examples were fabricated unless provable.
correction: Only cite statistics and case studies that are verifiable from a source already in hand (ideation doc citations, prior decks, or live web research with proof). Do not modify data-driven visuals (scatter, 2x2) that encode actual measured data. When proposing content for a presentation, label unverified examples as candidates requiring sourcing rather than presenting them as established facts.
